propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate allocated a crew of seventeen across a bottling plant's three high-speed lines each shift for four years under the plant's crewing plan, and resolved line stoppages with the shift maintenance technician under the stoppage procedure with each stoppage logged in the line system.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the stoppage log document the crewing and the stoppage handling.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran the shift start and hand-over briefings under the plant's briefing standard with the briefing records signed by the crew leads and audited monthly, and recorded the shift's output and downtime with line speed and changeover decisions staying with the production manager.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the briefing records and the reference call document the briefings and the decision boundary.

propositions.canonicalProposition: In the panel exercise the candidate ran a shift-start briefing covering line allocation, safety notices, changeover time and line targets in order, confirmed each crew lead's allocation by name, and finished within the five minutes the standard allows.
propositions.rationale: The interviewer note records specific observable behaviour tied to the briefing requirement, not an impression.

expectedGap: Hand-over conditions are documented on the hand-over sheet for the next supervisor, but the sheet's open items section is not audited in the materials.
expectedBoundaryNote: Record the interview observation as what was observed in one exercise; do not extend it into a general judgement of the candidate beyond that observation.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the hand-over sheet's open items were reviewed by the production manager and how often.
